The stronger issue is that existing repression and arbitrary detention continued alongside his reformist rhetoric, so the fear climate was reduced only partially, not clearly eliminated.","evidence":[{"title":"Thailand stresses the importance of upscaling humanitarian assistance along the Thai-Myanmar border at the Human Rights Council","publisher":"Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Kingdom of Thailand","date":"2024-03-04","url":"https://www.mfa.go.th/en/content/vfm010324-2?cate=5d5bcb4e15e39c306000683e&menu=5d5bd3da15e39c306002aafa","summary":"Thailand said it was deeply concerned about the Myanmar situation, expanded humanitarian assistance, and urged dialogue, reconciliation, and a peaceful, stable, unified Myanmar. This is strong evidence of trying to reduce insecurity through nonterroristic means.","question_ids":["3B.6","2B.5","2B.7"]},{"title":"ASEAN foreign ministers’ statement on escalation conflicts in Myanmar","publisher":"Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Kingdom of Thailand","date":"2024-04-18","url":"https://www.mfa.go.th/en/content/asean-fm-statement-escalation-conflicts-myanmar?cate=5d5bcb4e15e39c306000683e","summary":"Thailand joined a call for immediate restraint, cessation of violence, humanitarian access, and civilian protection. That is direct evidence of de-escalation rather than fear-based coercion.","question_ids":["3B.6","2B.5","2B.7"]},{"title":"Thailand and the ASEAN Chair’s Special Envoy stress de-escalation in Myawaddy","publisher":"Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Kingdom of Thailand","date":"2024-04-24","url":"https://www.mfa.go.th/en/content/pr210424-2","summary":"Thailand framed its border response as de-escalation, cessation of hostilities, and ASEAN coordination. This looks like contained crisis management, not a broad fear campaign.","question_ids":["3B.6","2B.5","3B.5"]},{"title":"Thailand sends a high-level delegation to Mae Sot to support local agencies","publisher":"Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Kingdom of Thailand","date":"2024-04-23","url":"https://www.mfa.go.th/en/content/dpmfm-dpmim-dm-nscsg-maesot-2?cate=5d5bcb4e15e39c306000683c","summary":"A civilian-security delegation including foreign affairs, defense, armed forces, police, and NSC coordinated support at the border. That is measured administrative crisis handling, not intimidation.","question_ids":["3B.6","3B.5","2B.5"]},{"title":"Thailand speaks at the HRC on promoting human rights on the ground","publisher":"Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Kingdom of Thailand","date":"2024-02-19","url":"https://www.mfa.go.th/en/content/vfm150224-2?menu=5d5bd3cb15e39c306002a9ac&page=5d5bd3cb15e39c306002a9ac","summary":"Thailand emphasized dialogue, constructive engagement, technical cooperation, and human-rights work on the ground. This supports a non-fear-based governance posture.","question_ids":["3B.6","3B.4"]},{"title":"Prime Minister delivers statement at 3rd Summit for Democracy","publisher":"Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Kingdom of Thailand","date":"2024-03-20","url":"https://www.mfa.go.th/en/content/summit-for-democracy-3-2?cate=5d5bcb4e15e39c306000683e","summary":"Srettha publicly tied his government to democracy, rule of law, and human rights at home and abroad. That is supportive evidence against a political fear climate.","question_ids":["3B.6","3B.4","3B.3"]},{"title":"Thailand ratifies disappearance convention, urges law on torture and enforced disappearance","publisher":"Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Kingdom of Thailand","date":"2024-05-16","url":"https://www.mfa.go.th/en/content/icpped140524-2?page=5d5bd3da15e39c306002aaf9","summary":"Ratifying the disappearance convention and backing anti-torture/anti-disappearance law is a concrete institutional step that should reduce fear of arbitrary abuse.","question_ids":["3B.6","3B.4","3B.1"]},{"title":"Thailand and the ICRC discuss humanitarian assistance without discrimination","publisher":"Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Kingdom of Thailand","date":"2024-04-26","url":"https://www.mfa.go.th/en/content/vfm-meets-with-icrc-reps-250424-2?cate=5d5bcb4e15e39c306000683e","summary":"Thailand discussed nondiscriminatory humanitarian assistance to all groups in Myanmar. This is evidence against collective-punishment logic and for reducing insecurity through lawful channels.","question_ids":["3B.6","2B.5","3B.5"]},{"title":"Thailand: New Government Slow to Protect Rights","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-01-11","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/01/11/thailand-new-government-slow-protect-rights","summary":"HRW said the new government had not undertaken serious rights reforms and should end politically motivated prosecutions. That suggests the broader fear climate remained in place.","question_ids":["3B.6","3B.4","3B.2"]},{"title":"Thailand: Investigate Detained Youth Activist’s Death","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-05-23","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/05/23/thailand-investigate-detained-youth-activists-death","summary":"HRW said hundreds of monarchy critics were in pretrial detention and called for a prompt investigation into a custodial death. That is evidence of continuing political fear, not its removal.","question_ids":["3B.6","3B.4","3B.1"]},{"title":"Thailand: Tragic death of detained activist must be a wake-up call","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-05-14","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/05/thailand-tragic-death-of-detained-activist-must-be-wake-up-call/","summary":"Amnesty said a peaceful protester was arbitrarily detained and died in custody. This is direct evidence that state coercion still produced fear and insecurity.","question_ids":["3B.6","3B.4","3B.1"]},{"title":"Thailand: Last-Ditch Effort for Tak Bai Massacre Justice","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-05-01","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/05/01/thailand-last-ditch-effort-tak-bai-massacre-justice","summary":"HRW said impunity for the Tak Bai crackdown persisted and called on Srettha to end it. Ongoing impunity for a major security-force abuse undercuts any claim that fear was being reduced lawfully.","question_ids":["3B.6","3B.2","3B.4"]},{"title":"Human Rights Council consultation with civil society on Thailand’s candidature","publisher":"Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Kingdom of Thailand","date":"2024-06-07","url":"https://thai-inter-org.mfa.go.th/th/content/%E0%B8%AB%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%A3%E0%B8%B7%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%B1%E0%B8%9A%E0%B8%9C%E0%B8%B9%E0%B9%89%E0%B9%81%E0%B8%97%E0%B8%99%E0%B8%9B%E0%B8%A3%E0%B8%B0%E0%B8%8A%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%AA%E0%B8%B1%E0%B8%87%E0%B8%84%E0%B8%A1%E0%B364%0%B8%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%A3%E0%B8%AA%E0%B8%A1%E0%B8%B1%E0%B8%84%E0%B8%A3?cate=62dfa3b9e5c6102618683d32","summary":"This is more positive than negative overall, but it also shows the government was seeking legitimacy abroad while domestic prosecutions and detention continued. It does not show the fear climate had been resolved.","question_ids":["3B.6","3B.4"]}]}
